name: audit_notifications
query: create table if not exists public.stock_movements (id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), distributor_id uuid not null references auth.users(id) on delete cascade, mitra_user_id uuid not null references auth.users(id) on delete cascade, item_id uuid not null references public.consignment_items(id) on delete cascade, request_id uuid references public.consignment_requests(id) on delete set null, previous_stock integer not null check (previous_stock >= 0), change_quantity integer not null, resulting_stock integer not null check (resulting_stock >= 0), movement_type text not null check (movement_type in ('initial_stock', 'supplier_stock_change')), reason text not null check (char_length(btrim(reason)) between 3 and 500), approved_by uuid not null references auth.users(id) on delete restrict, created_at timestamptz not null default now()); create index if not exists stock_movements_item_idx on public.stock_movements (item_id, created_at desc); create index if not exists stock_movements_scope_idx on public.stock_movements (distributor_id, created_at desc); alter table public.stock_movements enable row level security; create policy "Supplier can read own stock movements" on public.stock_movements for select to authenticated using (auth.uid() = mitra_user_id and auth.jwt() -> 'app_metadata' ->> 'distributor_id' = distributor_id::text); create policy "Manager can read workspace stock movements" on public.stock_movements for select to authenticated using (auth.uid() = distributor_id or (auth.jwt() -> 'app_metadata' ->> 'role' in ('admin', 'distributor') and auth.jwt() -> 'app_metadata' ->> 'distributor_id' = distributor_id::text)); create table if not exists public.notifications (id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), recipient_user_id uuid not null references auth.users(id) on delete cascade, distributor_id uuid not null references auth.users(id) on delete cascade, request_id uuid references public.consignment_requests(id) on delete set null, notification_type text not null check (notification_type in ('request_approved', 'request_rejected', 'stock_updated')), title text not null check (char_length(btrim(title)) between 1 and 120), body text not null check (char_length(btrim(body)) between 1 and 500), is_read boolean not null default false, created_at timestamptz not null default now()); create index if not exists notifications_recipient_idx on public.notifications (recipient_user_id, is_read, created_at desc); create index if not exists notifications_scope_idx on public.notifications (distributor_id, created_at desc); alter table public.notifications enable row level security; create policy "Users can read own notifications" on public.notifications for select to authenticated using (auth.uid() = recipient_user_id); create policy "Managers can read workspace notifications" on public.notifications for select to authenticated using (auth.uid() = distributor_id or (auth.jwt() -> 'app_metadata' ->> 'role' in ('admin', 'distributor') and auth.jwt() -> 'app_metadata' ->> 'distributor_id' = distributor_id::text));
